variants.label: SMX-II 24 V; exact owner-unit identification only

notes: The separate SMX-II schema and profile retain community-backed controls, but no generic SRNE descriptor selects them.

known_limitations: Automatic profile selection is limited to the one exact owner-unit serial confirmed by a 24 V nameplate; other SMX-II units remain read-only until independently identified.
A generic SR marker, serial number format, measured battery voltage or user-editable model label is insufficient.
The 20-33 V control limits and 0.2 V register scaling apply only to the 24 V profile.
knowledge_summary: Separate identity-gated 24 V SMX-II controls with exact-register readback; unknown and other SRNE models remain read-only.
